source_text: Ait prophetes esse viventem iustitiam; Apostolus dicit Christum iustitiam et sanctificationem et redemptionem. Quis surgere fecit ab oriente iustitiam, vocavit eam ad pedes suos? Pater vocavit Filium — incarnationem — de oriente lucis verae. Adoramus scabellum pedum eius.
pass_a_gloss: The prophet says there is living justice; the Apostle says Christ is justice and sanctification and redemption. Who made justice rise from the east, called it to his feet? The Father called the Son — the incarnation — from the east of true light. We adore the footstool of his feet.
pass_b_english: Isaiah already knows living Justice, not Paul alone: Christ is [[our righteousness, sanctification, and redemption >> Bible:1 Corinthians 1:30]]. [[Who raised up justice from the east and called it to his feet? >> Bible:Isaiah 41:2]] — the Father calling the Son from the true dawn. [[Worship at his footstool, for it is holy >> Bible:Psalm 99:5]].
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel.
anf_compare: no ANF for Jerome Isaiah homilies; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel
